terms.comment: To win a victory, victōriam adipīscī; over the enemy, victōriam reportāre ab hoste (Traupman 188).

phrases.latin: nōn omnia nīmīrum eīdem dī dedēre. vincere scīs, Hannibal; victōriā ūtī nescīs
phrases.english: the gods, it seems, have not given everything to one man: you know how to win, Hannibal, you do not know how to use a victory

phrases.latin: Bis vincit quī sē vincit in victōriā.
phrases.english: He wins twice who masters himself in victory.
to win a victory over the enemy
to let a sure victory slip through one’s fingers
to win a victory (over the enemy)
